label: Diesel engines less reliable with DPF and power issues
symptom: Diesels are less reliable than petrols, with potential for stalling at low RPM, power loss at high RPM, poor fuel economy, and DPF regeneration interruption risks.
cause: Emissions systems complexity, DPF operation, potential turbo or fuel system issues.
fix: Ensure proper DPF regeneration cycles, address potential sensor or turbo faults.
inspection_advice: Check service history for DPF issues, test drive for low-RPM stalling and high-RPM power delivery.
notes: Merges diesel reliability, DPF regeneration, low RPM stall, high RPM power drop, and poor fuel economy for diesel engines.

label: Timing chain tensioner failure on TSI engines
symptom: Rattling noise from engine, potential for catastrophic engine failure if timing chain jumps.
inspection_advice: Listen for rattling on cold start; check service history for tensioner replacement.
notes: Critical issue; can lead to engine destruction if not addressed. Merged with 'timing_chain_stretch'.

label: Manual clutch slips and wears prematurely
symptom: Clutch slips or shreds, even with standard engine power. The standard clutch is considered to be at its limit with factory power, especially if modified.
inspection_advice: Test clutch engagement for slipping during acceleration. Test clutch under hard acceleration.
notes: Merged from 'manual_clutch_slip_wear' and 'clutch_at_power_limit' as they describe the same clutch wear issue.

label: Turbo failure due to stop/start or early failure
symptom: Turbo failure caused by stop/start function leading to lubrication issues and overheating, or general failure leading to loss of power or boost pressure.
cause: Stop/start system lubrication issues or turbocharger fault
inspection_advice: Check turbo for signs of failure and ask about stop/start usage; check for boost leaks, unusual noises, or power loss.

label: Coolant leak from thermostat housing or water pump
symptom: Coolant leaking out of the thermostat water pump housing, causing low coolant warning or puddles on the garage floor.
cause: Faulty thermostat housing or water pump assembly.
fix: Replace the thermostat housing or water pump assembly.
inspection_advice: Check for coolant stains around the thermostat housing and water pump area. Inspect coolant level and condition.
notes: Merged from two video mentions describing the same coolant leak issue.

label: Sunroof leaks, rattles, squeaks, and cracks
symptom: Sunroof leaks during heavy rain, rattles and makes noises while driving, squeaks during operation, and can cause water leaks into the passenger side with staining on the A-pillar.
cause: Clogged drain holes, worn seals, or structural issues.
fix: Clean drain holes, replace seals, or repair/replace sunroof assembly.
warning_signs: Water stains on headliner or A-pillar
inspection_advice: Check for water stains on interior headliner and pillars. Operate sunroof to listen for noises. Inspect sunroof seals and drain holes.
notes: Merged multiple sunroof-related issues (clogging, rattle, leaks, squeaks, cracks) from two videos.

label: Plastic oil pan cracking and drain plug leaks
symptom: Oil pan cracks easily, even at stock height, leading to oil leaks. The plastic drain plug can also leak.
cause: Plastic oil pan and drain plug design prone to damage and wear.
fix: Replace with an aftermarket metal drain plug or new plastic plug. Repair or replace oil pan if cracked.
inspection_advice: Inspect oil pan and drain plug area for cracks, leaks, or seepage during oil changes.
notes: Merged plastic oil drain plug leak and plastic oil pan cracking issues.

label: Fuel pump nickel plating flaking and recall
symptom: Fuel pump fails due to flaking nickel plating. Potential fire hazard due to accumulation in the fuel tank suction pump.
cause: Degradation of nickel plating inside fuel pump. Design or manufacturing flaw leading to recall.
fix: Replace the fuel pump assembly. Check for and address any open recalls.
inspection_advice: Check service history for fuel pump replacement, especially on 2015 models. Check for any open recalls related to the fuel system.
notes: Merged fuel pump flaking and fuel tank suction pump recall issues. Specific to 2015 model year mention for flaking.

label: Carbon buildup on intake valves from direct injection
symptom: Reduced engine performance, rough idle, or misfires due to carbon deposits on intake valves.
inspection_advice: Check for rough idle or performance loss; consider valve inspection if high mileage.
notes: Common in direct injection petrol engines without port injection.

label: EA288 diesel timing belt side component failures
symptom: Strange hissing, chirping, or squeaking noises from timing belt area after cold start; coolant leak or failure; oil leak from front crankshaft seal; belt particles clogging oil strainer leading to low oil pressure.
cause: Premature failure of timing belt tensioner, water pump seal, front crankshaft seal, or oil pump belt disintegration.
fix: Replace timing belt and tensioner assembly, water pump, front crankshaft seal, oil pump belt, and clean oil strainer.
warning_signs: Hissing or squeaking noise on cold start
inspection_advice: Listen for unusual noises from timing belt cover on startup; check for coolant and oil leaks around timing belt area; inspect oil pump belt condition and oil for debris.
notes: Consolidates premature timing belt tensioner failure, water pump failure, front crankshaft seal oil leak, and oil pump belt disintegration from the same source video.
